rows.what_the_ink_shows: The lifts x-bar and y-bar are followed by membership in a superimposed N/G glyph. The left upright and diagonal of N remain visible; a rounded G body with an upper horizontal stroke and a right-hand angular return is also visible. The enlargement confirms an overwritten glyph but does not securely establish the chronological order of the two letters. Viewed crops/133_scan053_L855.jpg.
rows.note: L855.R1: The actual original LaTeX is already \unsure{G|N}, with G first. Retain that explicit uncertainty. The row’s definitive G reading is mathematically motivated, while the crop preserves clear strokes from both letters and does not independently establish which is final. This is therefore no new transcription correction: the existing unsure expression accurately records the optical ambiguity; no mathematical inference is used to erase N.
